text:
Hii everyone , I hope this will help somebody.
I'm an Israeli and my husband is now too after 8 years on visa B2 and A5, he got his passport for the second time now for 5 years.

His brother came to visit us from Serbia for 10 days, we prepared the following:
1. Printed ticket of his flight back.
2. Printed ETA visa approval.
3. Printed letter from his work, that he's an employee in this and this position and that he is on his vacation from that and that date and he's expected to come backe on that day to continue his work.
4. Printed letter from us explaining who we are , and what's the relationship between us (including his name and passport number), where he's going to stay for his whole trip, (he was staying with us so we included our address) we included also where we are working, our companys name , and our position, also our phone numbers , and i.d. numbers. I ASKED CHAT GPT TO REWRITE PROFESSIONALY AND HE DID. WE PRINTED IT , SIGNED IT, SCANED IT, AND SENT IT TO HIS BROTHER TO PRONT IT OUT.

At the airport he was asked all of the following questions, he just gave all the printed papers above and she was satisfied with it and let him enter Israel.

P.S. Every case is different, and not always that simple. 
I'm just sharing my story and hope this could help somebody ❤️
